Subject: Multi-stream failover + sponsor clip clearance

Hi team,

We need to lock the smoke test for the joint webinar (Bright Advertisers) and confirm final language for sponsor clip usage. High-level asks:

- Confirm availability for a cross-platform smoke test (Zoom -> ON24 failover + encoder switchover) on Thursday 7/8 at 10:00 PT.
- Ops: Ben, can you run the multistream failover checklist and confirm encoder switchover timing (we want <15s cut-over)? See my draft plan attached.
- Legal/Sponsor: Sanjay, we got your clause edits last week — please sign the clip clearance so we can publish the 30s sponsor clip in the post-webinar highlight. I attached the latest agreement (sponsor_clip_agreement_v2.pdf). If you need DocuSign, I'll send the link.

Notes on scope: the test will exercise a cold failover from Zoom hosted stream to ON24 RTMP ingest plus a hot-standby encoder change. We will also validate caption reconnection and recording continuity (must capture sponsor clip in both primary and fallback recordings).

Ben/Laura: please reply with the ops runbook you'd like to follow and the exact endpoints/ingest keys. Ops alias is copied into the Drive doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bSmokeTestPlan

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Events Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Date: 2027-06-07T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-stream failover + sponsor clip clearance

Marissa — thanks. Thursday 7/8 10:00 PT works for ops. Quick checklist summary (I attached the full smoke plan as multistream-smokeplan-0708.pdf):

1) Pre-test (09:15-09:45): encoder firmware check, key exchange, caption relay test
2) Primary run (10:00): stream to Zoom (primary), record local and cloud, verify sponsor clip insertion at T+18m
3) Simulated failure (10:12): drop primary, trigger ON24 RTMP ingest + switch encoder profile to standby bucket
4) Validation (10:13-10:30): verify audio/video continuity (<15s gap), captions resume, ON24 recording contains sponsor clip
5) Post-test (10:40): collect logs, transfer encoder configs (encoder_handshake_steps.txt).

Encoder endpoints I need from Zoom/ON24 teams: primary RTMP endpoint + stream key, oncall ingestion key for ON24, and whether we can pre-stage the ON24 session with a placeholder stream for faster ingest.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Events Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: multistream-smokeplan-0708.pdf, attachment: encoder_handshake_steps.txt)

Hi Ben/Marissa,

We can pre-stage an ON24 presentation room and reserve a hot ingest key for the 7/8 test. Recommended steps for fastest cutover:

- Pre-stage session with placeholder ingest bound to a reserved key (we will provide a static RTMP target so you can pre-configure encoder).
- Make sure the encoder supports immediate stream re-registration (GOP <2s helps).
- For captions, use our caption relay endpoint at caption.on24.net:7080 and allow a 10-12s reconnection window.

Provisioning details: (paste)
RTMP target: rtmp://ingest.on24.net/bright-evt
Reserved key (test): ON24-RES-9X7A
Pre-stage link: https://app.on24.com/p/prestage/bright-evt

We can also provide a short ingest-monitoring webhook to notify Redwood ops when ON24 has an active stream (helps automate verification). Let us know if you want us to enable that.

Best,
ON24 Support

Confirming we will be on 7/8 at 10:00 PT for the smoke test. If you want me to join ops Slack channel during the test, I can be available.

Thanks — Sanjay
